releaseLineage.targetPromotionPolicy: All new protected staging evidence must use the current candidate ledger. Any new selected SHA must be explicitly promoted by the release owner before evidence collection continues.

allowed: operator and reviewer roles or names

nog01.title: Protected staging activation evidence
acceptanceCriteria: workflow environment is exactly staging
selected SHA is exact and belongs to main
workflow checkout, deployed app checkout and health commit all match the selected SHA
runner labels include self-hosted, linux, x64 and tecpey-staging
runtime user and group match the governed non-root staging identity
application checkout is clean
health endpoint reports HTTP 200, health ok, production runtime mode, PostgreSQL ok and Redis ok
required systemd units and timers match release-rendered templates and are active
latest governed scheduler run is recent and succeeded
operational alert pending and quarantine counts are zero
requested synthetic alert probe is delivered
canonical and detached SHA-256 digests verify the accepted bytes

nog02.title: Redacted protected env evidence

environmentSourcePolicy.modeSelectionEvidence: Record only the selected mode and redacted proof disposition; never print raw values, host paths containing secrets, service manager output, or process environment dumps.
environmentSourcePolicy.serviceManagerPrecondition: If the protected environment is delivered by the service manager, env:check must run through a governed validation unit or equivalent service-managed command that uses the same environment source as the staging application. Direct operator-shell execution is rejected because it does not inherit the application service environment.

nog02.command: cd "$TECPEY_STAGING_APP_DIR" && set -a && . "$TECPEY_STAGING_ENV_FILE" && set +a && NODE_ENV=production npm run env:check
nog02.serviceManagerCommandShape: cd "$TECPEY_STAGING_APP_DIR" && sudo systemctl start "$TECPEY_STAGING_ENV_CHECK_UNIT" && sudo systemctl show "$TECPEY_STAGING_ENV_CHECK_UNIT" --property=Result --property=ExecMainStatus --property=ExecMainCode --value
acceptanceCriteria: environment source is recorded as protected_host_env_file or service_manager_preloaded_environment with redacted proof disposition
required public URLs are present and non-placeholder
required TecPey signing secrets are present, length-valid and distinct
TECPEY_CRM_PII_KEY_B64 decodes to exactly 32 bytes
trusted proxy header and hop count pass policy
DATABASE_URL is present and accepted without exposing its value
optional webhooks are HTTPS in production and paired with the required secret when enabled
legacy auth policy is disabled or within immutable sunset rules
AI Mentor models are in the approved allowlist when configured
CSP connection environment validation passes

rejectionConditions: selected SHA is not exact or does not match deployed app and health commit
GitHub Environment staging has no protection rules or required reviewers
workflow did not run in protected environment staging
runner labels or runtime user/group do not match governed staging host
required paths are symlinks where the contract forbids symlinks
health endpoint is not healthy for PostgreSQL or Redis
alert pending or quarantine count is non-zero
detached digest or verifier summary is missing

env:check fails, cannot run with the protected staging env file loaded, or cannot run through a governed service-manager validation unit/equivalent command that uses the same environment source as the staging application
